name: The Guitarist Emergency Gig Bag Pack
description: The exact boot-kit that saves your show: 1x pack Ernie Ball 10-46 Regular Slinky, 1x 10ft Tour Lead (silent gold plugs), 1x 50m Stage Matte Gaff Tape, and 1x fresh 9V Alkaline Battery.
gigNote: Every guitarist has been caught out at 7:15pm before soundcheck. Keep this in your gig bag pocket and never scramble again.

name: The Drummer Stage Survival Pack
description: Built for high-energy 2x45 minute sets: 1x pair Vic Firth 5A Hickory Sticks, 1x Remo Coated Ambassador 14" Snare Head, and 1x roll 50m Stage Matte Gaff Tape.
gigNote: When you put a stick through your snare head on song 4 of set 1, you have exactly 3 minutes between songs to change it. Don't gig without a backup head.

specs.Contents: Vic Firth 5A Pair, Remo 14" Head, 50m Gaff

name: Ernie Ball Regular Slinky (10-46)
description: The undisputed king of electric guitar strings. Custom nickel wound over high-carbon steel hex core for crisp top-end and reliable tuning stability under hot stage lights.
gigNote: The workhorse gauge for 90% of function and rock gigs. Stays in tune even after sweaty 90-minute sets.

name: Ernie Ball Super Slinky (9-42)
description: Silky-smooth bends and feather-light action. Perfect for Strat/Tele scale lengths when your fingers need to survive 3 sets without fatigue.
gigNote: If you're playing 4 nights in a row over a bank holiday weekend, 9s will save your calluses and forearm fatigue.

name: D'Addario EJ16 Phosphor Bronze (12-53)
description: Warm, resonant, projection-heavy acoustic strings. Corrosion-resistant phosphor bronze winding keeps tone crisp even in humid pub beer gardens.
gigNote: The standard for pub acoustic duo sets. Rich unplugged projection and cuts through the PA cleanly without harsh piezo quack.

name: Rotosound RS66LD Swing Bass (45-105)
description: Legendary British stainless steel roundwound bass strings. High-output midrange growl that cuts clean through live drum and guitar mixes.
gigNote: The strings that powered rock history. When you need the bassline to punch through a boomy room, Rotosound 66s deliver.

name: Vic Firth American Classic 5A Hickory
description: The world's most trusted drumstick. Dense USA hickory absorbs stage shock while tear-drop wood tips draw maximum acoustic tone from ride cymbals.
gigNote: The gold standard balance. Pitch-paired and weight-matched so each stick feels identical in your hands.

name: Vic Firth American Classic 5B Hickory
description: Beefed-up shoulder and thicker taper for loud unmic'd pub rooms, heavy rimshots, and rock authority without snapping.
gigNote: When the pub PA is only doing vocals and you need acoustic volume from the kit, 5Bs give you effortless power.

name: Remo Coated Ambassador 14" Snare Head
description: The open, crisp, singing snare sound recorded on thousands of hit records. 10-mil single-ply coated film with unmatched stick sensitivity.
gigNote: Tunes up fast in under 2 minutes. Delivers crisp brush work or cracking rimshots with equal ease.

name: Thingamagig Tour Grade 10ft Lead (Straight/Angle)
description: Zero crackle. 24k gold connectors, thick rubber outer jacket that coils flat without kinks, and dual internal heat-shrink strain relief.
gigNote: Right-angle plug fits flush into Les Pauls, Teles and pedalboard inputs without getting stepped on by clumsy frontmen.

specs.Guarantee: Free replacement if it ever crackles on stage

name: Thingamagig Tour Grade 20ft Balanced XLR Lead
description: Tour-duty oxygen-free copper mic cable with Chuck-type strain relief. Rejects lighting dimmer buzz and stage RF interference.
gigNote: The 20ft length gives vocalists and frontmen total freedom across wider stages without pulling over the mic stand.

name: Thingamagig Pro Stage Matte Black Gaff Tape (50m)
description: True non-reflective stage gaff. Tears clean by hand in straight lines, grips concrete and pub carpets, and leaves zero sticky residue on leads or floorboards.
gigNote: Never use cheap duct tape — it turns to sticky goo under hot stage lights and ruins cables. This is professional clean-peel tour gaff.

name: Thingamagig Industrial 9V Alkaline (6-Pack)
description: High-drain alkaline 9V blocks. Prevents mid-set acoustic pickup distortion, dying wireless beltpack dropouts, and bass active preamp fizz.
gigNote: Active bass or acoustic pickup dying mid-set sounds like horrible distortion. Always pop a fresh 9V in before major shows.

name: Thingamagig Fast-Response Chromatic Clip-On Tuner
description: Lightning-fast piezo vibration sensor. Tunes accurately even while the drummer is soundchecking his kick drum right next to you.
gigNote: Mic tuners fail in loud backstage rooms. This reads direct neck vibrations only, so you can tune up in 5 seconds flat.
